definitions.explanation: Being with someone; doing something jointly.

examples.japanese: {一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きましょう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This and that are the same.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The two answers are the same.

examples.japanese: {一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}りましょう→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}する→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧。
examples.english: I take walks with my dog.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: That's the same as my thinking.

examples.japanese: {一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昼|ひる}ごはん→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べません→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would you like to have lunch together?

examples.japanese: A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧⟦けれど→けれど：01990_keredo⟧、⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A and B are different sizes, but they're the same shape.

notes:
{一緒|いっしょ} covers being with someone and being the same as something else.

USAGE:
- Before a noun it takes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, never な: {一緒|いっしょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧ (the same school)
- {一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ is the adverbial form and is by far the commonest shape of the word
- It also means "all at once, in one lot": ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧ (wash it all in one load)
- ⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is the humble form, used when joining someone senior

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb: do it together — {一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: together with — ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: is the same — ⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一緒|いっしょ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ is the other word for "same". It modifies a noun directly (⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧, not ×{同|おな}じ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧) and is the neutral choice in writing. {一緒|いっしょ} in the "same" sense is conversational.
- ⟦{共|とも}に→共に：03468_tomoni⟧ is the formal written equivalent of {一緒|いっしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧
